differences.what: Explicit comparison/outperformance claim against the named reference method

rationale: The write-up presents the stance vector purely as a self-authored, self-contained construction and never names, cites, or compares against any prior white-bear-style reference, framing its two findings as wholly new. The closing message, by contrast, explicitly names and reproduces a 'white-bear' stance vector from the directed_modulation bank as an orienting baseline (cosine ≥0.83 to the final vector) that the submitted method is said to beat, which is information the write-up omits entirely.
